persona: Beginner piano player/songwriter who knows chord names but has no DAW experience or prior RILL knowledge.
goal: Create soft chord progression with an accompanying tune using included instruments, optionally a spacious effect, then save and export.

session.method: Isolated native Xvfb desktop, mouse/keyboard driver; all app decisions from screenshots; no app source, docs, tests, internal state or MCP inspected. Required AGENTS.md read only.

outcome.status: Created and saved/exported through visible UI; subjective sound quality unverified.
outcome.composition: Four bars at 80 BPM, C major: C-F-G-C triads with generator velocity 65 on R1 Mini String Pad; second R1 Mini track named melody with 15 manually drawn notes, ending on half-note C5. R1 Spacer Tape Echo modified to enable Reverb at 20% mix on melody.
outcome.project_save: UI title changed to Soft-Song after saving exports/Soft-Song.rill.
outcome.audio_export: UI confirmed Exported · Soft-Song.wav; default Mix/WAV/32-bit float/Follow audio setup/Arrangement/include tails.
outcome.audio_evidence: Coordinator extracted actual 12-second playback audio with peak -6.8 dBFS and mean -20.8 dBFS. Verifies nonzero output during earlier playback, not timbre, chords, or subjective audio quality. Final playback failed with stream-disconnected banner.

chronological_discoveries.observation: Participant brief prepared; required AGENTS.md read. Waiting for isolated desktop READY before interacting.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Start an original slow song from a blank canvas.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Blank project has prominent Choose instrument action.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Find a piano or soft string sound.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Choose instrument; inspect three built-in cards; choose R1 Mini; open preset menu; select Pad · String Pad.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Found a plausible soft sound, but instrument cards do not describe sound families. Synth controls are unfamiliar; preset names make the choice possible. Browser reports 0 plug-ins despite three visible built-in instruments.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Double-click an empty pattern to write notes.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Double-click center and lower body of pattern; Cancel rename; right-click.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Double-click opened Rename twice. Right-click reveals Edit notes and succeeds.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Use chord names to make C-F-G-C, one bar each.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Generate > Chord; set length 1; set velocity 65; Add notes; Next range; change roots and repeat; Done.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Four visible triads with correct note names, and clip automatically extends to four bars. Next range is helpful.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: C major chord notes should not look erroneous.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Inspect Key menu after seeing red E, A and B notes; change Natural minor to Major.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Default key Natural minor conflicts visually with default generated Major triad. Inferred red means outside scale. Changed scale to Major. Also set tempo to 80 BPM through direct text entry.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Keys · Plucked Keys preset should supply a playable included keyboard sound.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Add R1 Sampler; choose Keys · Plucked Keys; click Load sample.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Preset still displays No sample; Load sample opens empty Recent files. No included sound discovered. Cancelled and changed instrument to Mini, choosing Sync Lead.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Rename second track Melody after changing its instrument.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Double-click track title (nothing visible); right-click Rename; type Melody; Apply name.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Track remains R1 Sampler. May require explicit field focus despite selected-looking text. Deferred recovery.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Draw a simple tune above chords.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Edit notes; Pencil; drag first quarter note; click subsequent pitches, drag final half note.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: 15 visible notes over four bars; previous drawn length reused; clip automatically grows. Keyboard pitch labels only C octaves, but inserted note labels confirm pitches. Playback transport advances. Sound not yet verified.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Add a spacious echo or reverb to melody.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Instrument > Effects > Insert; choose R1 Spacer; Open editor; choose Tape Echo; drag Mix to 20%; enable Reverb.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: One active R1 Spacer, Tape Echo modified with reverb enabled and 20% mix. Preset selection helpful. Some clicks missed because dialogs shifted positions between initial animation screenshot and settled UI; one opened Assistant accidentally, recovered with Back. No subjective effect sound confirmed.

chronological_discoveries.actions: Played composition twice. Coordinator extracted actual recorded output.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: UI displayed Audio output stream failed or disconnected banner. Coordinator measured a 12-second excerpt from 16:40:57 with peak -6.8 dBFS and mean -20.8 dBFS, verifying nonzero audio. No subjective listening claim. Audio error is environment-confounded.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Typing in a focused name field and Ctrl+S work.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Retried track Properties Name, then used on-screen Keyboard to rename melody. Coordinator investigated focus issue.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: On-screen keyboard successfully renamed melody. Coordinator confirmed Xvfb focus stayed on root after file picker due to no window manager, fixed driver focus restoration. Ctrl+S immediately worked afterward. Earlier ignored text and shortcuts are environment-confirmed, not product findings.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Save editable project and a playable audio file.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Ctrl+S; save Soft-Song.rill in session exports; File > Export WAV; retain Mix/WAV/32-bit float/Follow audio setup/Arrangement/Include effect tails defaults; choose suggested Soft-Song.wav.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Title changed to Soft-Song. Export progress visible. Technical export settings unfamiliar; trusted defaults.

chronological_discoveries.expectation: Confirm export and replay final arrangement.
chronological_discoveries.actions: Observed Exported confirmation; switched to Arranger and pressed Play.
chronological_discoveries.outcome: Two four-bar tracks visible and export confirmed. Final Play failed with Audio output stream failed or disconnected and Retry playback. Session ended; no sound-quality claim.

issues.title: Empty-pattern double-click opened Rename instead of note editing
steps: Create a new project and add R1 Mini.
Double-click center and lower body of the empty New pattern clip.
issues.expected: Open a place to enter notes.
issues.observed: Rename controls appeared twice. Editing was discoverable only after right-clicking and finding Edit notes.
issues.recovery: Cancel rename, right-click clip > Edit notes.
issues.confidence: high for observation; beginner expectation, not a claim that double-click behavior is unintended

issues.title: Sampler sound preset did not include a sound
steps: Add R1 Sampler for a keyboard melody.
issues.expected: A built-in preset named Plucked Keys supplies a playable keyboard sound.
issues.observed: No sample remained after preset selection. Load sample opened empty Recent files, with no included sample library discovered.
issues.recovery: Cancel file picker, Change instrument to R1 Mini, choose Sync Lead instead.
issues.confidence: high for visible no-sample state and discovery failure; no claim that the unloaded sampler was audibly tested

issues.title: Default scale colored newly generated major chord notes red
steps: Generate default Major triad C, then F and G.
issues.expected: Valid major chords should look normal in a C-major song.
issues.observed: Editor default was Key C · Natural minor, while generator default was Major triad. E, A and B appeared red with no immediately visible explanation.
issues.recovery: Found Key > Scale > Major; notes then displayed without red.
issues.confidence: high for contradictory defaults; interpretation of red as error is simulated novice reaction

issues.title: Device browser count contradicted visible built-in instruments and effects
steps: Open Choose instrument, later Effects > Insert.
issues.expected: Number of available devices matches cards and collection counts.
issues.observed: Top-right 0 plug-ins appeared alongside three built-in instrument cards and All plug-ins 3; later six effect cards and All plug-ins 6.
issues.recovery: Ignored zero and selected visible built-in cards.

issues.title: Dialog repositioning caused clicks to miss their intended controls
steps: Use displayed Insert or Open editor position after initial screenshot.
issues.observed: Dialog changed vertical position after initial rendering; first attempt at Insert opened Assistant, and first Open editor click needed repeating. This is susceptible to screenshot timing and animation in the study driver.
issues.recovery: Back from Assistant, capture settled state, retry at new coordinates.
issues.confidence: medium; report as interaction observation, not confirmed product defect

issues.title: Keyboard focus lost after native sample file picker
issues.classification: confirmed study environment issue, excluded from product defects
steps: Open and cancel native Load sample picker.
Attempt track rename using text; try Ctrl+S.
issues.expected: Typed characters and shortcuts reach the app.
issues.observed: Text and shortcuts ignored. Coordinator confirmed Xvfb focus was on root window due to absent window manager; fixed driver restoration.
issues.recovery: On-screen keyboard renamed melody before fix; Ctrl+S worked immediately after coordinator driver correction.

issues.title: Audio output stream disconnected during study
issues.expected: Reliable auditioning of composition and effect.
issues.observed: Persistent stream failed/disconnected banner; final Play failed and offered Retry playback. Coordinator confirmed isolated sink still running and recurring ALSA EIO across sessions, cause unresolved. Earlier captured output had nonzero signal.
issues.recovery: Completed visual composition and exported WAV; did not attempt low-level repair.
issues.confidence: high for visible failure; low for product attribution

successes: File > New provided a clear Start a song entry point and Choose instrument button.
Instrument preset names enabled a soft-pad choice despite unfamiliar synthesizer parameters.
Generate Chord accepted familiar chord roots; Next range enabled four-bar progression without manual note entry.
Generator previews and final note-name labels made C-F-G-C verifiable visually.
Pencil instruction Draw notes · Drag to set length was useful; last duration reused on subsequent clicks, and clips grew automatically.
Effects tab and Insert led to built-in Spacer, with visible active count and preset selector.
On-screen keyboard provided a mouse-only recovery path for track naming.
Save and export succeeded through UI after environment focus recovery; suggested WAV filename and folder were correct, and explicit export confirmation appeared.
unresolved_questions: Can users find included acoustic piano or sampled keyboard sounds without providing external files?
Would a newcomer understand red out-of-scale notes without knowing the key setting?
Are default sampler presets intended as parameter templates requiring an external sample?
How do the selected synth presets and echo/reverb actually sound in the final export? No subjective listening occurred.
Does the dialog repositioning affect ordinary desktop users, or mainly initial screenshot timing?
limitations: Simulated novice, not a recruited human participant; music vocabulary limited to assigned piano/songwriter persona.
No subjective audio audition claim. Captured signal verified by coordinator only; stream disconnections limited listening confidence.
Native file picker focus issue was confirmed environmental and repaired by coordinator during session; related noops must not be counted as product bugs.
Some early screenshots capture popup transitions, making misses partly timing-dependent.

Read required AGENTS.md, but no other repository docs, app source, tests, prior studies or internal state were used. Saved artifact existence checked only by filenames; coordinator owns file-content verification.
No source changes, fixes, AI composition request or external plug-in installation performed.
